name: Sun Cleric: Nysoni's Blessing gives a Seraphim Seraphim's Light on Dawn (#11431)
contract: Nysoni's Blessing (520639) grants a spec-dependent reward whenever Dawn (804584) activates; for the
Seraphim specialization (ChrSpecs 48, identity spell 92137 Angelic Presence) its tooltip names Seraphim's
Light (520641), a stamina/intellect/strength-scaling absorb shield. ActivateDawn gated the shield on the
obsolete spec passive 800586, which no current Seraphim owns, so Dawn granted nothing. A Seraphim with
Nysoni's Blessing must gain Seraphim's Light with a positive absorb amount when Dawn activates.
